name: paprika3d
description: Three.js MCP server and Claude Code plugin: build three.js games and 3D pages end to end, from references and a design doc to playtesting, models and a published link. It tells the agent what is on screen, what never appears, what each input changed and what a frame costs, finds models in a library of 57,732 or builds them in code, and in Claude Code runs the whole flow with /paprika3d:paprika-make and /paprika3d:paprika-loop.
